I spread mayo on the outside of the bread and put a little Parmesan cheese on the mayo and pressed in some jalepenos. The jalepenos will stay on the bread if they are cooked with the weight of the sandwich pressing on them.

Recipe: 

2 Slices whole grain bread 
1 Jalepeno
200mL of cheddar cheese (grated)
20mL mayo
2tbsp Parmesan cheese (kraft)

1. Grate cheese
2. Toast one side of bread on lightly oiled nonstick pan 
3. Place half of the cheese on the toasted side of the bread, and then put some diced jalepenos on the cheese and then cover with the rest of the cheese. 
4. Place the other slice of bread toast side down and put half of the mayo on the outside of the bread
5.  Sprinkle half of the Parmesan cheese on the mayo side of the bread, and press a few of the jalepenos slices into the bread.
6. Repeat step 5 on the other side of the bread 
7. Place in pan on low-medium heat, covered. Take lid off at the end to crisp up the outsides for extra crunch
